items.title: Search and read notes
items.description: Search Xiaohongshu, read note details and inspect profiles through MCP tools.

items.title: Publish and interact
items.description: Publish content and perform supported comment, like, collect and notification actions.

items.title: Built-in QR login
items.description: Vetta obtains a QR code from the upstream login API and trusts only the upstream status API for sign-in state.

items.title: Managed local runtime
items.description: Vetta downloads and verifies the official release binary for your platform; no Go or manual MCP configuration is required.

items.title: Install this Ability
items.description: Vetta selects the matching official release, verifies its SHA-256 and installs it in an isolated runtime directory.

items.title: Complete QR login
items.description: Open the sign-in flow in Vetta and scan the QR code with Xiaohongshu. Cookies are stored outside the versioned runtime.

items.title: Configure if needed, then use
items.description: Optionally enter a proxy under Connection settings. Saving does not start QR sign-in; Vetta connects to the upstream service directly over managed loopback HTTP.

blocks.title: First run
blocks.content: The official server downloads its bundled browser on first use (roughly 150–190 MB). Network access is required once; the browser cache is kept separately from your login data.

## Privacy and account safety

This Ability connects to the official `xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp` server. Vetta stores cookies in its managed Ability data directory and does not place them in the versioned executable directory. Review the upstream project's terms and Xiaohongshu account policies before publishing or interacting at scale.
